facts.text: Storm: 48 mm in the catchment, 2026-10-27 14:00–20:00. Raw turbidity AIT-101 ~6 NTU until 27th 20:00, rising to ~38 NTU by 28th 02:00, ~38 since.
Plume reached the intake ~01:30 on the 28th.
F07 filtrate turbidity AIT-157: ~0.12 NTU, starts rising 04:10, crosses 0.3 at ~05:20, HH alarm 0.5 at 06:20, 0.62 at 07:00.

F07 last backwashed 2026-10-25 18:00 → run time 61 h at 07:00. SOP-FLT-02 triggers a backwash at filtrate ≥ 0.3 NTU, headloss ≥ 2.0 m or run ≥ 48 h. F07 headloss (tag PDT-157) 2.3 m at 07:00. F07's 48 h backwash fell due 27th 18:00 and was **deferred by shift A** to protect RES-2 level (team decision memory DEC-OPS-1027, by S. Dlamini, approved by phone by J. van Wyk).
Field note FN-2026-031 (T. Khumalo, 2026-09-12): mud-balling seen in F07 media; media inspection WO-26051 planned, not done.
Other filters F01–F06, F08: filtrate 0.10–0.16 NTU, runs 20–44 h.

Clarified turbidity AIT-301 2.9 NTU (target < 3). CL-4 out of service since 2026-10-01 for refurbishment (PRJ-CL4); RES-2 cell B being relined (PRJ-RES2), so clarification limits the works to 90 ML/d although the intake brings 118 ML/d (FIT-102).

Coagulant DP-2 / FIT-201: flat at 127 L/h since a calibration drift on 2026-10-20 (confirmed spec band 128–142 L/h, spec v3). SOP-COAG-01 dose table at raw turbidity 30–40 NTU calls for **150–165 L/h** → under-dosing during the storm is a contributing cause.

RES-2 level LIT-501: 38 % at 07:00, falling ~2.5 %/h, about 11 h of supply to zones Z13–Z15 (~41 000 people). Low limit 50 %. SOP-RES-01: below 6 h of supply, alert the works manager and open the outage-notice draft.

HLP-B drive-end bearing TT-612: 64 °C on 21 Oct rising ~2 °C/day to 78 °C at 07:00. Band 40–70 °C; OEM alarm 85 °C, trip 95 °C. Last greased 2026-08-02; SOP-PMP-04 greasing interval 2 000 running hours (≈ 83 days) → overdue since 2026-10-24. Field note FN-2025-118 (R. Ndlovu, 2025-06-14): "grease the drive end first; if it is still climbing after 24 h, check coupling alignment." WO-26058 HLP-B bearing inspection open, due 2026-10-30, assigned N. Mokoena, needs permit (PTW) and isolation per SOP-ISO-01.
Lab final-water turbidity grab samples: 0.18 at 2026-10-27 22:00, 0.31 at 04:00, 0.44 at 06:00 on the 28th. SANS 241 limit 1 NTU; works operational target 0.5 NTU.

Past incident INC-2024-07 (2024-02-11): a storm plume plus a long filter run caused breakthrough on F03; the fix was an early backwash plus a 20 % coagulant step-up; lesson: "during storms, backwash early and jar-test before the plume arrives".
